title: Time Jump: 11:15, Two Hours Under Stop-Work

fields.scenarioTitle: Hairline Crack — Centrifuge Failure, Exposure Clocks & Rumor
fields.narration: It is now 11:15. The shared centrifuge room on Lindgren's third floor has been under stop-work for almost two hours. The stop-work sign is still on the door. Dr. Ahlgren's cell biology run finished at 10:10, and those tubes are still sitting in the second centrifuge. Three more third-floor groups have cancelled their afternoon bookings. Prairieline Lab Services has confirmed it cannot inspect the rotor before Friday at 08:00. The @lindgren_late_nights post has passed 300 reposts. The 'missing vials' rumor from Lindgren four is now spreading in the same thread, next to the words 'lab leak'. The Halvorsen Herald's 11:30 deadline is fifteen minutes away. Lena has been seen at the Occupational Health Clinic. One cell biology technician still has not come in. The IBC chair has not yet classified LI-2026-0142, and the sponsor row on the EHS portal clock board still reads 7 days. Take two minutes. Each of you, tell the room where your piece stands right now.
worldState: Clock: 11:15. Discovery was at 09:02. The PI's call to the BSO was received at 09:20.

The stop-work sign is still on the shared centrifuge room door, Lindgren third floor. The rotor, buckets and lid are untouched and the lid is closed. No written stop-work record or lifting decision has been sent to the floor.
Dr. Ahlgren's cell biology run ended at 10:10. Its tubes are still in the second centrifuge in the same room, and no one has entered to remove them.
Three more third-floor groups have cancelled afternoon centrifuge bookings. One earlier group's question about using a centrifuge on another floor has not been answered.
Prairieline Lab Services (PLS-SR-26-3318) will visit no earlier than Friday 16 Oct, 08:00–12:00. A loaner unit can be delivered Thursday for $410/week, but no one has ordered it.

Lena Park was seen at 10:20. Her follow-up is booked for Thursday at 09:00, and she must not enter the room before then. The clinic physician is still waiting for the PI's written description of the event.

One cell biology technician has still not come to the clinic. Five other people on the L3-CENT-A badge list have not been contacted. The clinic's last walk-in slot today is at 16:15, and the clinic closes at 17:00.

On LI-2026-0142, the IBC classification is still NOT YET SET. Clock board row 3 (sponsor notice) still reads 20 Oct 09:02 (7 days), even though the award record states the Iowa Corn Growers Board's 72-hour term.
ULT-L4-09: the 14-vial discrepancy in rack C is unresolved and the box search has not started. Nobody outside HSU has been called about it.
@lindgren_late_nights has passed 300 reposts. Replies, including @corn_and_code, link the freezer count to the third-floor event and say 'lab leak'.
The Halvorsen Herald reporter expects an answer by 11:30. University Communications has not issued a public reply.
fields.facilitatorNote: This card resets the room and asks for a status check, not new decisions. Go round the table: BSO, PI, IBC, RC, PIO, then IO. If the RC has not yet caught the 72-hour sponsor term, do not point it out. Let the board's '7 days' stay on screen.

instructorNote: This card re-baselines every role at the two-hour mark. Check three things: the BSO confirms the stop-work is holding and is recorded in writing (BSO Program 4), the RC notices that the clock board still shows 7 days instead of the 72-hour award term, and the PIO can say whether the BSO's one-hour fact sheet arrived and whether a holding statement is ready before the Herald's 11:30 deadline.
